acceptance_clause: aos doctor --capabilities --runtime <runtime>는 위 matrix의 실제 상태와 근거 source를 출력해야 한다.
no_silent_estimation_clause: native event가 없다는 이유로 조용히 추정하지 않는다. DERIVED 근거가 없으면 UNAVAILABLE이다.
not_user_failure_clause: adapter coverage 부족을 사용자 능력 부족으로 해석하지 않는다.
declared_only_statement: A doctor report is a projection of the frozen capability matrix, not a probe of an installed runtime. Status, source class, evidence locator, missing effect, digest coverage, verdict, exit code, reason order and every projection line are recomputed from specs/adapter-capabilities.v0.json and compared. Four inputs are declared and unverifiable here: assessment_mode names the session the caller asked about, and runtime_version, protocol_or_schema_version and adapter_version are the installed versions the caller reports, checked for shape only. The evidence locator is proved to reproduce the frozen matrix cell, never proved to name a source that exists or was read. The fourth is prose: the nine statement fields of this document are checked for presence and non-emptiness only, the derivation never reads one, and a statement that contradicts its own row's pinned source clause, predicate, exit code or verdict id is accepted, so no issuer may read a statement as a rule.

derivation_proofs.proof: recompute the workspace diff and every artifact digest from the pre-run and post-run runner filesystem snapshots, and reject the reconstruction when a snapshot pair is missing
reconstruct plan, state transition, checkpoint and stall events from the runner state artifacts and the runner watchdog timeline, and reject the reconstruction when the artifact chain is incomplete

assessment_modes.source_clause: Verified Assessment: AOS controlled wrapper가 시작부터 종료까지 감싼 세션만 공식 AOS-Coding P0 발급 가능
assessment_modes.statement: The caller reports a session the AOS controlled wrapper wrapped from start to end. This contract records that claim and does not verify it; deciding it needs a trace and belongs to session-class.v0.

assessment_modes.source_clause: Imported Session: 기존 Codex·Claude Code 기록의 사후 분석은 DIAGNOSTIC ONLY
assessment_modes.statement: The caller reports a post-hoc Codex or Claude Code record. SSOT 9.2 admits such a session only as DIAGNOSTIC ONLY, so no official AOS-Coding P0 may be issued from it however complete the adapter's capability is.

verdicts.source_clause: REQUIRED: scored run에 반드시 필요. 누락 시 관련 metric 또는 전체 점수 차단
verdicts.statement: The adapter cannot observe an event group whose absence blocks the run or the score, so no AOS-Coding P0 can be issued until the capability is restored. This is an adapter limitation and never a user failure.
verdicts.predicate: at least one event group is UNAVAILABLE and its 누락 처리 effects do not fall to NOT OBSERVED

verdicts.source_clause: Imported Session: 기존 Codex·Claude Code 기록의 사후 분석은 DIAGNOSTIC ONLY
verdicts.statement: The adapter's capability is sufficient, but the session the caller named is an imported record, so the output is DIAGNOSTIC ONLY.
verdicts.predicate: no such group is UNAVAILABLE and the report declares an imported session

verdicts.source_clause: UNAVAILABLE: adapter가 관찰할 수 없음. 관련 metric은 NOT OBSERVED
verdicts.statement: One or more event groups are unobservable and their metrics fall to NOT OBSERVED. A score may still be issued, with those metrics outside the eligibility denominator rather than scored as failures.
verdicts.predicate: no such group is UNAVAILABLE, the report declares a controlled assessment, and at least one event group is UNAVAILABLE and falls to NOT OBSERVED

verdicts.source_clause: Verified Assessment: AOS controlled wrapper가 시작부터 종료까지 감싼 세션만 공식 AOS-Coding P0 발급 가능
verdicts.statement: Every event group of the frozen matrix is observable at its declared status and the caller named a controlled assessment, so nothing in the adapter's capability stands between this runtime and an official AOS-Coding P0.
verdicts.predicate: no event group is UNAVAILABLE and the report declares a controlled assessment

reason_codes.statement: Reported once per unobservable event group whose 누락 처리 column blocks the run, blocks the score or withholds it.
reason_codes.predicate: one event group is UNAVAILABLE and its 누락 처리 effects do not fall to NOT OBSERVED

reason_codes.statement: Reported once when the caller named an imported session.
reason_codes.predicate: the report declares an imported session, which SSOT 9.2 admits only as DIAGNOSTIC ONLY

reason_codes.statement: Reported once per unobservable event group whose 누락 처리 column falls to NOT OBSERVED.
reason_codes.predicate: one event group is UNAVAILABLE and its 누락 처리 effects fall to NOT OBSERVED
